objective: Falsify or promote seven complementary non-index-calculus mechanisms for generic prime-field ECDLP.

shared_contract.curve_scope: prime-order short-Weierstrass curves over generic prime fields
required_controls: matched random cycle or operator ensemble

tasks.title: Extend null models for structural probes
tasks.falsification_gate: The control suite must reject injected coordinate artifacts and recover injected weak signals before interpreting any lane.

tasks.title: Test orbit and semigroup decompositions
tasks.promotion_gate: A public quotient or orbit strategy reduces normalized search cost across held-out curves after all maintenance overhead.

tasks.title: Probe symbolic dynamics of addition walks
tasks.promotion_gate: A symbolic feature changes a concrete walk decision and improves collision cost or computes a useful scalar predicate after overhead.

tasks.title: Search potential-theoretic functional coordinates
tasks.promotion_gate: A stable public function predicts useful displacement or collision progress and yields an end-to-end operation advantage.

tasks.title: Triage categorical and functorial embeddings
deliverables: minimal executable toy probe or barrier theorem
tasks.promotion_gate: At least one finite construction exposes scalar-action structure not present in matched random actions without assuming ECDLP.

tasks.title: Test topology of trajectories and recurrence graphs
tasks.promotion_gate: A stable topological feature improves a concrete search decision; visual separation alone is marked DOES_NOT_SURVIVE.

tasks.title: Evaluate probabilistic constraint propagation
tasks.promotion_gate: Public observations cause reproducible entropy reduction that composes into a cheaper verified ECDLP algorithm.

tasks.title: Measure random-matrix and operator-statistics deviations
deliverables: public operator and covariance matrix definitions
spectral-gap, spacing, localization, and low-rank tests
tasks.promotion_gate: A replicated ensemble deviation supports a specific cheaper algorithmic decision; statistical novelty alone is insufficient.

tasks.title: Audit complementary lanes
tasks.falsification_gate: Any candidate lacking an explicit algorithmic use or failing a matched null is marked DOES_NOT_SURVIVE.
